items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Oh, but that man could blow some trumpet.

ctx.x: Is he related to Harold Dajon, the clarinet and saxophone player? You know the saxophone player Harold Dajon from his?
Oh, yeah, I know this one. But there was no can. No can. No can. But there were two brothers, Dajon and Joe. Both of them would play trumpet at Laplace. And they would help you play on your bass?
Yeah, on the band, you know.

items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: The interviewer mentions King Oliver and asks the interviewee about him, but the interviewee does not respond with any personal anecdote, memory, or confirmation of a direct relationship.

ctx.x: See, they had King Oliver. What did you call him? King Oliver?
King Oliver had that big eye. He used to work at Second Magazine as a butler and used to play music. Well, in them days, that was the Eager Band.
